IMFM-M1.description: Inelastic Material for Auto Generation (IMFM-M1). Keyed by the material id; the record links a model material to inelastic (fiber) material properties, and exactly one of CONCRETE or STEEL is provided according to whether that material's type is Concrete ("C") or Steel ("S").

CONCRETE.description: Concrete material setting. Provide this (and not STEEL) when the material referenced by the key has type Concrete. Assigns inelastic material properties for unconfined concrete, optionally confined concrete, and rebar.

UN_CONC_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic (fiber) material used as the unconfined concrete material. Must reference an existing inelastic material; otherwise the request is rejected.

CONF_CONC_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic (fiber) material used as the confined concrete material for columns. Empty string means no confined concrete is assigned. If non-empty, must reference an existing inelastic material.

REBAR_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic (fiber) material used as the rebar material. Must reference an existing inelastic material; otherwise the request is rejected.

STEEL.description: Steel material setting. Provide this (and not CONCRETE) when the material referenced by the key has type Steel. Assigns the inelastic steel material.

STEEL_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic (fiber) material used as the steel material. Must reference an existing inelastic material; otherwise the request is rejected.
